name: Los Villares (Spain)
description: Quartered red and white above and green and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Villares (a castle, a lion, a key and a sword).
history: Municipal flag of Los Villares; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Los Villares arms — castle, lion, key and sword
